import ast,json,typing
from pathlib import Path

B=Path('.dedup-work/immich12-20261021')
def original(file,names,env):
 t=ast.parse((B/file).read_text());t.body=[ast.ImportFrom(module='__future__',names=[ast.alias(name='annotations')],level=0)]+[n for n in t.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names];ast.fix_missing_locations(t);exec(compile(t,str(B/file),'exec'),env);return env
log=N(**{k:lambda *a,**kw:None for k in ['warn','warning','info','error']})
assets={i:N(autoId=i,id=str(i),simOk=False,jsonExif=N(exifImageWidth=None,exifImageHeight=None,fileSizeInByte=None),fileCreatedAt=None) for i in range(1,4)}
edges={1:[1,2],2:[1,2,3],3:[2,3]}; assigned={};queries=[]
def neighbors(ids,threshold):
 queries.extend(ids);return {i:[N(aid=j,isSelf=i==j) for j in edges[i]] for i in ids}
pics=N(getByAutoId=assets.get,setSimGIDs=lambda aid,gid:assigned.update({aid:gid}),setSimInfos=lambda *a,**kw:None)
db=N(pics=pics,vecs=N(findSimiliar=neighbors),dto=N(thMin=.95,rtreeMax=100,gpsk=N(eqDt=False,eqW=True,eqH=False,eqFsz=False)))
e=original('src--db--sim.py',{'processChildren','checkGroupConds'},dict(db=db,lg=log))
done=e['processChildren'](assets[1],neighbors([1],.95)[1],[2],lambda *a:None)
result={'chain_group':{'edges':edges,'assigned_group_by_asset':assigned,'visited':sorted(done),'pair_1_3_in_candidate_graph':3 in edges[1]},'missing_width_condition':list(e['checkGroupConds']([assets[1],assets[2]]))}
assert assigned=={1:1,2:1,3:1};assert result['missing_width_condition']==[True,'']
saved=[]
env=original('src--imgs.py',{'saveVectorBatch'},dict(db=N(vecs=N(save=lambda aid,vec,uid:saved.append(aid))),lg=log,extractFeaturesBatch=lambda images:[[1.0]],extractFeatures=lambda image:[1.0]))
returned=env['saveVectorBatch']([assets[1],assets[2]],'thumbnail',preloaded=(['image1','image2'],[assets[1],assets[2]],[]))
result['short_vector_batch']={'input_assets':[1,2],'returned_asset_ids':[a.autoId for a,error in returned],'saved_asset_ids':saved,'errors':[error for _,error in returned]};assert len(returned)==1
# This adapter intentionally violates normal extractor cardinality to test the save boundary's error handling.
(B/'controls-v1-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
findings: Original processChildren groups a synthetic A-B-C similarity chain under A despite absent A-C candidate edge; groups describe connected similarity, not all-pairs verified duplicate identity.
Original checkGroupConds with width equality enabled accepts two present EXIF records whose widths are both None; missing values are treated as equal.

Original saveVectorBatch with a deliberately shortened extractor result saves/reports only first of two assets with no error for omitted asset: zip truncation at boundary. Normal extractFeaturesBatch aims to preserve cardinality, so this is an injected robustness case, not evidence that normal model returns short batches.
processChildren expands descendants without reapplying checkGroupConds or filename-exclusion checks; first-level findGroupBy checks do not establish all descendant metadata equivalence. Static scope.
Qdrant candidate requests default limit=100 and do not request exhaustive exact search; no all-neighbor recall proof. Non-self scores above 1 are dropped even if produced by floating point overshoot.
Empty vector query results trigger clearing vectorized flags/deleting points in callers; missing data and index/repair states need separate qualification. No live delete executed.
imgs converts RGBA only; grayscale/palette/CMYK are not converted to RGB by that function. EXIF orientation/transparency composition policies and real model behavior unqualified.

CPU automatic worker count min(cpuCnt//2,cpuCnt) is zero for one CPU; model initialization has no lock under CPU threading; cancellation can leave submitted work executing. Source-level observations only.
src/api.py explicitly marked currently unused; active wrappers catch request errors and return None. No network requests or credentials used.

tests/test_vec.py depends on configured data and fixed asset IDs, imports old top-level vecs before path insertion, uses removed getBy calls and old save signature in some tests. Not a hermetic regression suite; not executed.
Qdrant/FAISS memory and reliability statements in docs are project claims, not measurements validated in this review.
